card.name: Cursetounge Kavu
card.text: When this creature enters, target creature gets -0/-4 until end of turn. If you targeted a creature you control this way, you draw two cards and lose 2 life.

card.name: Captain Hoyrik
card.text: Whenever Captain Hoyrik or another nontoken creature you control with power 2 or less enters, scry 1, then draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.

card.name: Echoes Across Time
card.text: Flying, ward {1} Whenever you cast a sorcery spell from your hand, you may cast an instant spell with lesser mana value from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If a spell cast from your graveyard this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.

card.name: Memories of Futures Lost
card.text: Menace Whenever Memories of Futures Lost deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card. When you do, choose one— • You may play the discarded card this turn. (You still pay its costs. Timing restrictions still apply.) • Create a Treasure token.

card.name: Stock Up
card.text: Look at the top five cards of your library. Put two of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

card.name: Subversive Sleeper
card.text: Flash When this creature enters, if it was cast, counter up to one target spell, then return up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
When this creature enters, if it was cast, untap each basic land you control.

card.name: Heron-Blessed Angel
card.text: Flying Humans and other Angels you control have vigilance. When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Human creature token.

card.name: Merrell, Tuinvale Glamerist
card.text: Flying Merrell's power is equal to the number of artifacts you control plus the number of enchantments you control.

card.name: Kul, Time Crack Instigator
card.text: When Kul enters, discard a card, then create two Junk tokens. (They're artifacts with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.") Paradox — Whenever you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.

card.name: The Admiral's Coffers
card.text: When The Admiral's Coffers enters and at the beginning of your first main phase, create two Treasure tokens. {T}, Sacrifice another Treasure: Add three mana of any one color. {5}, {T}, Sacrifice The Admiral's Coffers Add ten mana of any one color.

card.name: Keyn and Ruckus, Wild Pair
card.text: Trample Whenever you choose one or more modes for a spell or ability, put two +1/+1 counters on Keyn and Ruckus. If those modes were for an ability of another creature you control, you may put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

card.name: Claire, Batfolk Astrologer
card.text: Flying Whenever Clair or another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life. Whenever another creature you control with flying enters, each opponent loses 1 life.

card.name: Grete, Odric's Right Hand
card.text: Grete's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control plus the number of legendary permanents you control. (Legendary creatures count twice) When Grete enters, exile target nonland permanent you don't control until she leaves the battlefield.

card.name: Himoto, Kami of the Spark
card.text: Himoto can't be blocked. Whenever Himoto deals combat damage to a player, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your graveyard and the other into your hand.
